nodes.name: Canonical Ownership.md
nodes.summary: Dev_graph constraint node (CON-003) mandating exactly one canonical node per implementation concept to prevent semantic drift and ambiguous retrieval. Defines pre-creation search, Smart Connections duplicate detection (>85% similarity), and monthly audit as enforcement.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the dev_graph constraint node template: Definition, Purpose, Architecture Role, Constraint Expression (pseudo-formal), Severity, Verification, Enforcement Rules, Exceptions, and a Relationships block of [[wikilinks]] for Neo4j export.

nodes.name: Frontmatter Required.md
nodes.summary: Dev_graph constraint node (CON-002) requiring every content node (excluding structural files) to carry valid YAML frontmatter with all universal fields, making nodes queryable by Dataview, filterable by MCP, and exportable to Neo4j/Postgres.
nodes.languageNotes: Constraint Expression encodes the required-fields-and-enum invariant in pseudo-code; verification is a Dataview missing-frontmatter query plus per-session and weekly lint.

nodes.name: No Wiki Mutation.md
nodes.summary: Dev_graph constraint node (CON-001) establishing a hard boundary that dev_graph sessions MUST NOT modify wiki/** or raw/** files, preserving the integrity of the separately-governed knowledge layer in the two-graph architecture.
nodes.languageNotes: An exception-free blocking constraint; verified via git diff --name-only path checks, session-log audit, and MCP write_note/patch_note path restrictions.
